notes.title: TCPingInfoView 1.5.0.0
notes.content:
Updates to v1.5.0.0

Origin Updates:

 Config can be saved when changed.
 Added Windows Title Customization (Steam Version is Rich Presence Customization)
 Added Color of Latency, Reverse DNS Timeout, Latency Timeout, TCPing Interval setting.
 Added a simple editor for Endpoints.


Steam Version Updates:

 You can switch languages manually by setting in your steam settings window.
 Added Rich Presence Customization.
